screen_services.semantics: Exactly MOV DWORD [0x642c54],0; RET. Invalidates the saved-background-valid flag; does not allocate/free pixels or acquire a mutex.
screen_services.remaining: No new original/native execution. Interactions with other writers and caller lifetime remain separate.

screen_services.semantics: Early returns for disabled cursor, class22, null ordinary surface interface or any negative saved rectangle coordinate. After INFINITE Wait with ignored result, a nonzero saved-background flag and nonzero wrapped width/height select deferred58d5b0 or direct58c4a0 from641fc8 to6a49e0, with negative saved offsets clamped to zero; ReleaseMutex follows. The helper does not itself clear the saved-background flag.
screen_services.dependency: Saved rectangle/coordinates, wrapper backing and deferred queue lifetime.
screen_services.remaining: Zero sizes are rejected; negative differences and overflow are not positively validated by this local body. Real mutex abandonment/failure, all writers/aliases, callee faults and complete callback lifetime remain separate.

Guard mode3 matches owned physical backing, requires exactly one same-thread Lock with no DC/storage DC, and enforces a single guard interval.
Requires unique current-thread/current-epoch full Lock, exact pixels/dimensions/pitch/masks and generation/nonce before publication.
